blocks.x: Input cost per hectare down 14%, precision agronomy at cooperative scale

A European agri-cooperative (4,200 farms): Agricultural operations live by the season: one wrong input decision or one cold-chain gap shows up in yield, quality or compliance. The Achala team started where that cost concentrates —. The baseline signed in week two made the cost visible in units the finance team already owns, and the engagement ran under the standard Achala charter — a named metric, a named control owner and gates that evidence every move.
Field sensing patchy; variable-rate practice guesswork.
Yield/quality discovered at intake; advisory capacity constrained. Harvest logistics by phone; windows missed.

The field sensor fabric (soil/weather/crop with governance) feeds agronomy models per plot; advisory assistants extend each agronomist to 3x farm coverage; harvest orchestration schedules machines and crews against weather windows; and the agronomy platform unified machine, lab and advisory data per plot.
